caption:
113,235 reviews. 4.6 stars. For a $13 sheet set, that's rare.

Most sheet sets don't cross even a thousand reviews. This one has over 113,000, and the average still holds at 4.6 stars. That volume makes the rating harder to dismiss as luck or a review farm.

This is a 4-piece queen set in grey with a 16-inch deep pocket, built to stay on thicker mattresses, plus a fitted, flat, and two pillowcases in a soft, breathable weave. A rating that high across 113,235 reviews points to consistent results across a huge number of beds, not a handful of lucky buyers.

For $13.31, you get a full queen set that fits deep mattresses without shopping around for extra-deep options. The review count alone makes it a low-risk swap for a worn-out set.
